title: nephrodium nymphale
intro: Nephrodium nymphale, commonly known as Lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Matoniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lady fern are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which are said to soothe irritated tissues and promote the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of Lady fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
